title: Removed Items Revived
description: adds many of the blocks and items that were removed or were planed to be added
body:
This mod adds items and blocks  that were either removed or were planed to be added but never were.
Blocks and items include
-studed armor set
-ruby armor set
-ruby ore 
-ruby block 
-ruby material 
-element paintings
-wax block
-sculk jaw
-rotate tool
-dirt slab
-netherite stairs
-fish barrel 
-empty barrel
-spawn block 
-teleportor block
-glowing obsidion 
-chalkboard 
-spawn block
-funky portal
-block inspector 
-copper horn
-nether reactor core block and structure 
-fire block
-soul fire block
